Competition Commission of India Paid Legal Internship

One-month internship on competition law at CCI, starting on the first working day of the chosen month; about 15 seats per month.

STIPEND / MONTH
₹15,000
Stipend details
₹15,000 per month honorarium.
Batch deadline
To be confirmed
Format & location
In person · New Delhi
Who can apply
Indian law students: 3-year LLB in 2nd/3rd year, 5-year integrated LLB in 4th/final year, and LLM students, with an institutional recommendation. Students with a placement in hand are excluded.
Accommodation & support
Honorarium only; no accommodation or travel support listed

Entry notes

  • Rolling monthly batches; the last reported deadline was 30 September 2026. Pick your month on the form.
  • 2–3 month internships may be considered with an institutional recommendation.
  • Law
  • Competition law
  • Policy
  • Economics
